subtopic: inverse operations and changing the subject
microSkill: reverse a chain of operations using inverse pairs (+/-, x/div) applied in reverse order
objectiveWording: Identify and apply inverse operations - undoing a sequence of operations in reverse order - to isolate a target quantity.
successCriteria: States the inverse of each operation and recognises +/- and x// as inverse pairs.
Undoes a two-operation chain in the correct reverse order (e.g. for 'multiply by 3 then add 2', subtract 2 first, then divide by 3).
Changes the subject of a simple formula by applying inverse operations to both sides (e.g. make r the subject of C = 2*pi*r).
notation: the operation applied last is undone first

sourceReferences.locator: Middle School Topic 10: Algebraic Notation, Substitution & Formulae (changing the subject)
Middle School Topic 12: Linear Equations (the golden rule; inverse pairs)

externalAlignments.label: Algebraic notation and manipulation of formulae

microSkill: multiply each term inside one bracket by the term outside, preserving signs
objectiveWording: Expand a single bracket of the form k(ax + b) using the distributive law, distributing the sign correctly across every term inside.
successCriteria: Distributes a negative multiplier across all terms, e.g. -2(x - 5) = -2x + 10 and -(x - 4) = -x + 4.
Expands then collects like terms with a trailing expression, e.g. 5 + 3(x - 1) = 3x + 2.

sourceReferences.locator: Middle School Topic 11: Simplifying, Expanding & Factorising (A2)
